text: Coty is a very professional and fast plumber. Water was backing up my bathtub. After Rooter Pro was informed of it, they sent Coty and the problem was solved within 3 hours after it was reported.

author: spencer balcerzak
text: Carl was amazing. He showed up in about 30 minutes after calling on a holiday weekend to fix a leaking stop valve and had it fixed very quickly and non invasively, even with having to run to the store for an extra part or two. Not to mention, the price was very reasonable for the holiday weekend and fast response time! We will absolutely be using Rooter Pro again for all of our plumbing needs.

author: Tim Ritterling
text: Erick. The guy. Appointment at 2. I think came at 2:05. That's amazing. I had no drainage. Afraid to flush. Snaked 48 feet in my 100 year old house. I highly recommend this company!!!

author: Jessica Jaworski
text: I had a plumbing issue to where my basement sink was filling up with water and food particles as well as when I ran my washing machine the water was splashing out of the PVC pipe and into the floor. I called them today around 8am and they were here by 10am. They fixed the issues within 20 mins and Jacob took the time to explain things to me and what I could do to help maintain healthier drains. Very kind, knowledgeable, and professional! I would recommend this company to anybody! Very reasonable prices too I had to pay $60 less than what I was quoted over the phone! Thank you Rooter Pro you guys made me day!😊
